title: ProducerSecretIssued
description: OUTPUT-ONLY, SHOWN ONCE. Response to registering a producer or rotating its secret (PRP-41). secret is the only place in admin v1 where a credential value appears: it is generated server-side, returned once in this response, never stored (only secret_sha256 is) and can never be read back. It must not be logged, audited, cached or placed in a prompt; the audit record carries secret_sha256 only. No request schema may reference this schema.

secret.description: Newly generated producer secret (URL-safe base64, at least 256 bits). Present the credential as Bearer <producer_id>.<secret>.

shown_once.description: Always true: the secret cannot be retrieved again; rotate to get a new one.
